# kion_idms_open_id_group_association (Resource)

Manages a group association for a Kion OpenID Connect IDMS.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "kion_idms_open_id_group_association" "example" {
  # Optional
  # assertion_name  = "example"
  # assertion_regex = "example"
  # open_id_id      = 1
  # update_on_login = false
  # user_group_id   = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `assertion_name` (String) AssertionName name of the assertion in OpenID.
- `assertion_regex` (String) AssertionRegex is the regular expression used to determine a match.
- `open_id_id` (Number) The ID of the OpenID IDMS the group association belongs to.
- `update_on_login` (Boolean) ShouldUpdateOnLogin denotes if the group associations should be updated every time a user logs in.
- `user_group_id` (Number) UgroupID is the ID of the user group this assertion will map to.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Group Association ID.
